tool_args.rationale: All five observations have positive gain at H ≤ 0.48, while the forecast target is H = 24.2. The slow-horizon probe measures near the predicted reversal and directly constrains the slow component before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon rows constrain the net early gain but not the slow amplitude and time constant well enough to forecast the reversal.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly test the late-horizon reversal.
